title: GraphQL Relay Forward Root Connection Closure
supportedOperation: An unaliased top-level search connection using positive first and optional after, with edges and pageInfo.hasNextPage directly selected.
negativeProposition: The exact root forward search connection has zero edges and no next page.
notes: Backward last/before and mixed pagination are outside v0.3.
A request with a non-null after cursor is segment-only.
GraphQL errors block a negative license even when partial data is present.
The declared GraphQL service instance, authority context, and proposition scope are hash-bound into the observation.
